caseName: Michigan Citizens for an Independent Press v. Thornburgh
caseNameFull: Michigan Citizens for an Independent Press v. Thornburgh, Attorney General of the United States

opinions.text:
C. A. D. C. Cir. [Certiorari granted, 490 U. S. 1045.] Motion of respondent Detroit Free Press for reconsideration of the order denying the motion of divided argument [492 U. S. 936] denied.

Justice White took no part in the consideration or decision of this motion.
